ceilings.hint: Use on ceilings/critical light to minimise roller marks.

bathrooms.hint: Moisture + mould resistance for humid rooms.

tieBreakers: Prefer washable/scrub-class paints (e.g., Optiva) over Vinyl when durability is requested.
Prefer water-based enamels (Helmi/Everal Aqua) for interior trim unless solvent-based specifically required.
